SELECT COALESCE(fn_get_cd_nm('STATUS', state), '미확인') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, CASE WHEN state = '10' THEN '#4285F4' WHEN state = '20' THEN '#34A853' WHEN state = '30' THEN '#FF9800' WHEN state = '40' THEN '#EA4335' WHEN state = '99' THEN '#6B9BF2' ELSE '#333333' END AS fill FROM utb_app_mst WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq}
AND create_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND create_at <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY state, CASE WHEN state = '10' THEN '#4285F4' WHEN state = '20' THEN '#34A853' WHEN state = '30' THEN '#FF9800' WHEN state = '40' THEN '#EA4335' WHEN state = '99' THEN '#6B9BF2' ELSE '#333333' END, fn_get_cd_nm('STATUS', state)

SELECT CASE WHEN app_classification = '30' THEN '해외' ELSE '국내' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, CASE WHEN app_classification = '30' THEN '#F28B82' ELSE '#4CAF50' END AS fill FROM utb_app_mst WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq}
AND create_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND create_at <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY app_classification, CASE WHEN app_classification = '30' THEN '해외' ELSE '국내' END, CASE WHEN app_classification = '30' THEN '#F28B82' ELSE '#4CAF50' END

SELECT COALESCE(fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category), '기타') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, CASE WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '특허' THEN '#6B9BF2' WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '실용신안' THEN '#4CAF50' WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '디자인' THEN '#F5C542' WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '상표' THEN '#F28B82' ELSE '#333333' END AS fill FROM utb_app_mst WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq}
AND create_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND create_at <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY right_category, CASE WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '특허' THEN '#6B9BF2' WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '실용신안' THEN '#4CAF50' WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '디자인' THEN '#F5C542' WHEN fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category) = '상표' THEN '#F28B82' ELSE '#333333' END, fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', right_category)

SELECT M.app_seq AS app_seq, M.app_no AS app_no, M.app_name_ko AS title_ko, M.app_state AS app_state_code, COALESCE(C1.cd_nm, '상태미지정') AS app_state_name, M.state AS state_code, COALESCE(C2.cd_nm, '상태미지정') AS state_name, TO_CHAR(M.create_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS create_date, fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', M.right_category) AS right_category FROM utb_app_mst M LEFT OUTER JOIN utb_code_dtl C1 ON C1.grp_cd = 'APP_STATE' AND C1.dtl_cd = M.app_state AND C1.del_yn = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN utb_code_dtl C2 ON C2.grp_cd = 'STATUS' AND C2.dtl_cd = M.state AND C2.del_yn = 'N' WHERE M.office_seq = #{officeSeq}
AND M.create_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND M.create_at <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY M.create_at DESC LIMIT 10
